origin: Previously exported mip0 textures from user-installed Halo Campaign Evolved; no new downloads, extraction, or game changes

files.encoding: Linear BC5 RG; B=0. Shader reconstructs positive normal Z, flips DirectX G, then remaps XYZ to [0,1].
Linear masks; G roughness verified by existing paving shader/receipt. R occlusion nearly constant; B/A not used.

material_changes: Broad slab-scale value and roughness regions, sparse directional weathering, subtle native machining; old atlas and fine-noise bump removed
geometry_policy: Metric planar UV per unique shared mesh after finalscale; material-slot overrides only; no transform bake or mesh duplication
